goal: Generate a 2:3 or 3:4 single-screen cross-cultural tea-themed poster, with a Japanese magazine cover feel but friendly to Chinese readers, not imitating specific magazine styles.

title_block.subtitle_zh: Shizuoka and Fuding: A Tale of Two Cities of Tea and Ware
title_block.subtitle_en: Dialogue between Shizuoka Pottery and Fuding White Tea
title_block.alignment: Top right vertical large title, middle left horizontal Chinese, bottom left sponsorship and exhibition date in small text, grid in 10 columns
title_block.hierarchy_rule: Japanese main title line > Chinese subtitle line > Japanese secondary line > exhibition period and other metadata

meta.venue: 杭州 · 之江文化艺术中心
meta.presenter: East Asian Folk Art Revival Association · Zhijiang Cultural Investment

main_visual.description: Lower left 40% is a top-down shot of an open piece of celadon tea bowl + a single tea leaf about to fall onto the rim of the bowl, background is light indigo flat paint with washi paper texture, not drawing actual trademarks on the bowl
main_visual.position: Lower left, giving the upper right Japanese vertical arrangement and top edge 15% breathing space

design.zh_font: Hua Wen Hei Ti or Source Han Serif, from thin to medium, used for Chinese subline and exhibition information
design.en_font: Japanese fonts use Hiragino Kaku Gothic or Source Han Sans Japanese version, vertical layout follows punctuation rules; Latin is used only for independent half-width lines of numbers like year titles
design.grid: 8 column vertical division, landscape area occupies 2 column widths

must_keep: Japanese and Chinese each use their corresponding glyph systems, not mixed into the same vector file
The main visual tea bowl does not feature commercial brands and may have abstract patterns.
Completed with three main colors on the full page (indigo, paper, young grass accents ≤6% area on leaf veins)
avoid: Display Japanese text in Chinese Song font
Vertical and horizontal line spacing is too tight, forming 'tofu blocks'
Add English Details Block on One Image
